 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. The second ODI of the five-match series between India and New Zealand will be played at Hnry Stadium, Wellington, on Saturday.
 India lead the series 1-0 after winning the rain-hit first ODI in Auckland by five wickets.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement They chased a revised DLS target of 143 in 32 overs and reached it in 22.4 overs, with Virat Kohli scoring 74 off 51 balls after Rohit Sharma was dismissed for a duck.

 Shubman Gill will captain India in the first three ODIs, with Shreyas Iyer taking over for the fourth and fifth. Sharma and Kohli return for the 50-over format as India aim to build on their winning momentum after winning the T20I series 3-2 on the tour.
 On the other hand, New Zealand are dealing with injuries. While Rachin Ravindra and Mark Chapman have been ruled out of the series, Devon Conway will not participate in the second ODI due to concussion, with Nick Kelly called up. New Zealand were bowled out for 185 in the first ODI.

 Is Hnry Stadium pitch a batting or bowling wicket?
 Hnry Stadium is usually a good all-round pitch, favouring both batters and bowlers. The new ball is likely to get some life, and the ball tends to come on nicely, which makes it easier for batters to score after settling down.
 The venue has hosted both high-scoring and low-scoring ODI games, so early wickets may matter a lot.

 What is the average ODI score at Hnry Stadium?
 Hnry Stadium has yielded an average first-innings total of 268 in the last eight completed ODI games. The average second-innings score in the same games is 208, which shows that teams batting first have had the better of it.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Based on these numbers, the teams could look for a score between 250 and 290.
 MORE: Shubman Gill captaincy record in all formats listed 
 Highest team total at Hnry Stadium in ODIs
 New Zealand hold the record for the highest ODI score at Hnry Stadium, when they scored 393/6 against West Indies in March 2015. They won the match by 143 runs.
 Lowest team total at Hnry Stadium in ODIs
 England have the ignominious record of the lowest score achieved in an ODI at this ground. They were all out for a mere 89 against New Zealand in February 2002, losing by 155 runs.
 Highest individual score at Hnry Stadium in ODIs
 The highest-ever individual ODI score at Hnry Stadium belongs to former New Zealand opening batter Martin Guptill. He achieved an unbeaten score of 237 against the West Indies in March 2015, and New Zealand won the match by 143 runs.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Best bowling figures at Hnry Stadium in ODIs
 New Zealand's Tim Southee owns the record for best figures in an ODI match at Hnry Stadium. He took 7/33 against England in February 2015, and New Zealand won the match by eight wickets.
 Most runs at the Hnry Stadium in ODIs
 New Zealand batter Kane Williamson is the highest scorer in ODI cricket matches at Hnry Stadium. He has scored 473 runs from nine innings at Hnry Stadium, including one century and four fifties.
 Most wickets at the Hnry Stadium in ODIs
 New Zealand's Tim Southee also leads the wicket-taking list at Hnry Stadium in ODIs. Southee took 25 wickets in nine matches played at the Wellington ground.
